name: Kafka + Kafka UI
description: Single-node Apache Kafka (KRaft mode, no ZooKeeper) with Kafka UI for browsing topics, messages and consumer groups.

source.name: Apache Kafka official image docs + kafbat/kafka-ui (maintained fork of provectus/kafka-ui)

notes: Single broker, no authentication — for local development only. The advertised listener is set to localhost:${KAFKA_PORT} so clients on the Mac host connect directly at 127.0.0.1:${KAFKA_PORT}; clients inside the compose network use kafka:29092.
